content:
We've heard multiple rumors about Apple's next-generation iPad mini, including an OLED display and improved water resistance.

A new leak today suggests the upcoming iPad mini will pack serious power: an all-new A20 Pro chip.

MacRumors today spotted references to the new iPad mini in Apple's code, including an icon that appears to represent the device.

The icon shows the new iPad mini will share a similar overall design to the current model. However, the camera has been moved from the top bezel to a landscape side, aligning with Apple's other iPad models. There's also a small speaker opening at the top of the display, similar to iPhones.

The code also reveals the new iPad mini will feature an A20 Pro chip, the same chip used in last week's iPhone 18 Pro lineup. The currently available iPad mini was released in October 2024 with an Apple A17 Pro chip.

According to Mark Gurman, the new iPad mini is expected to go on sale before the end of October. Beyond these changes, the new iPad mini is reported to offer better water resistance and a new speaker system.

For more details, check out our full preview roundup of the new iPad mini.

In a separate report today, specs for the next-generation base iPad were also revealed, including an A19 chip, 8GB of RAM, and Apple's custom N1 and C1X connectivity chips.
